now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#22
now.text: As the Tinkerer, Mason arms the Sinister Six and the Enforcers against Spider-Man.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The hero the Tinkerer's gadgets are built to beat.

proposed.text: Tombstone hires the Tinkerer to build new gear for the Enforcers, who use it to nearly beat Spider-Man.

changes.evidence: In Probable Cause (#22) the Tinkerer only builds new suits for Shocker, Fancy Dan and Ox on Tombstone's orders. His work for the Sinister Six is Reinforcement and Shear Strength (#16-17), so the current text sums up several episodes in one.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#23
now.text: As the Master Planner, Doctor Octopus plots against Spider-Man from a hidden lair. In the Valentine's Day gang war, Spider-Man subdues him, and he is arrested.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The hero who foils Otto's plots and has him arrested.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Master Planner, whom Peter subdues in the gang war.

proposed.text: At the Valentine's Day summit, Doctor Octopus turns on Spider-Man in the gang war, but Spider-Man ties up his arms and he is arrested.

changes.evidence: Plotting as the Master Planner from a hidden lair happens in Blueprints to Shear Strength (#14-17), where he is unmasked. In Gangland (#23) he only fights at the summit and in the gang war, where Spider-Man subdues him, ties up his arms and gets him arrested.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#23
now.text: Hammerhead enforces for the Big Man and fights Spider-Man again and again. At the Valentine's Day summit, his betrayal sparks a gang war Spider-Man has to stop.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Fights Hammerhead again and again, a constant thorn for the Big Man.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Big Man's enforcer, whom Peter fights again and again.

proposed.text: At the Valentine's Day summit, Hammerhead betrays the crime bosses and starts a gang war that Spider-Man has to stop.

changes.evidence: Gangland (#23): Hammerhead sedates Sable and sets the bosses on each other, then runs when Tombstone fires him. Tombstone, Silvermane, Doctor Octopus and Spider-Man fight it out. 'Enforces for the Big Man and fights Spider-Man again and again' sums up several episodes and does not happen in #23.

owner_calls.question: The Final Curtain (#26) stage only says Mary Jane HAS given Gwen a makeover. The makeover comes earlier, while Gwen is dating Harry and before the Goblin takes over at #23 (the wikis list it before 'Venom Returns', #20). Neither wiki names the episode. Keep it at #26, or move it to the episode where Gwen first appears without glasses (likely Growing Pains, #19, but that needs a check by watching)?
options: Move to the episode where Gwen first appears without glasses (confirm which)
owner_calls.evidence: Both wikis put the makeover in Gwen's dating-Harry period, before the Green Goblin takes over the underworld (Gangland #23). Neither says it happens in Final Curtain.

owner_calls.question: Both card lines say Peter fights Hammerhead 'again and again'. On screen they only clearly fight over the Rhino specs in Accomplices (#21). In Gangland Hammerhead runs off, and the fight is among Tombstone, Silvermane, Doctor Octopus and Spider-Man. Keep the card lines, or soften them (for example 'Stops the gang war Hammerhead starts')?
options: Soften card lines to what is on screen
owner_calls.evidence: Hammerhead runs after Tombstone fires him. The wikis list fights with Spider-Man at #21 and Spider-Man rescuing him at #9.
